name: Villanueva de la Serena (Spain)
description: Nine horizontal stripes, five white and four blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de la Serena (a tree, a mermaid and waves, with the motto PUERTA SOY DE LA SERENA).
history: The municipal flag was adopted by the council in plenary on 30 December 1981; it is a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of four blue stripes on a silver ground, giving nine stripes of identical dimensions, five silver and four blue, with the municipal arms in its colours at the centre.

features.role: Villanueva de la Serena arms — tree, mermaid and waves, with motto
